title: feat: complete Prompt Arena product polish
body:
## P6 — Product polish

Stacked after the P5 BYOK slice; PRs #17–#20 remain draft.

- expands Overview into a local-data dashboard with actionable navigation and recent Arena evidence
- adds local diagnostics for bridge, storage, runtime, capabilities, platform, protocol, and network boundaries
- improves persisted Runs/Arena-summary history, verified response visibility, accessible states, and bounded evidence tables
- adds sanitized deterministic JSON, Markdown, and CSV exports for persisted Arena summaries
- preserves browser-preview honesty, local appearance/reduced-motion controls, and no hidden network calls
- removes stale provider foundation copy
- validates with 74 TypeScript tests, 99 Rust tests, typecheck, Vite build, cargo fmt/check, and diff checks via canonical BL4 app_server

P6 remains IN PROGRESS pending native Tauri/WebView accessibility and smoke review, security review, and publication gates.

No merge, tag, release, deploy, or public release is included.
